metadata.name: SBP ETGRMF
metadata.description: The Enterprise Technology Governance and Risk Management Framework (ETGRMF) is a mandatory regulatory framework issued by the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) for financial institutions to ensure robust IT governance, information security, and operational resilience.
metadata.classification_reasoning: The SBP ETGRMF is a mandatory regulatory framework issued by the State Bank of Pakistan for financial institutions operating under its jurisdiction. It provides baseline requirements for technology governance and risk management, with specific compliance deadlines and enforcement mechanisms.
metadata.framework_purpose: To establish comprehensive technology governance and risk management requirements for financial institutions in Pakistan, ensuring the stability and security of the financial sector's IT infrastructure.
metadata.framework_scope: All financial institutions regulated by the State Bank of Pakistan, including banks, DFIs, microfinance banks, and other entities under SBP's supervisory purview.
framework_objectives: Establish effective IT governance structures aligned with business objectives
Ensure robust IT service delivery and operations management
Manage technology acquisition and implementation risks
Maintain business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities
Enable effective IT audit and oversight mechanisms
metadata.target_audience: CIOs, CISOs, IT Governance Teams, Compliance Officers, Internal Auditors, and Board Members of SBP-regulated financial institutions
metadata.penalty_for_non_compliance: Non-compliance may result in regulatory penalties, restrictions, and enforcement actions as per SBP regulations and the Banking Companies Ordinance.
adoption_approach: Review current IT governance and security practices against framework requirements
Conduct gap assessment across all six framework domains
Develop implementation roadmap with prioritized action items
Implement required controls and governance structures
Establish ongoing monitoring and reporting mechanisms
Submit compliance reports to SBP as required

controls.title: Board responsibility to establish technology governance framework
controls.description: The Board must create a governance framework to ensure technology aligns with and supports the organization's goals.
controls.full_text: The Board of Directors of the FI(s) are responsible to establish a comprehensive enterprise technology governance framework which defines the leadership, organizational structures and processes to ensure that the FI(s)' technology sustains and extends the enterprise's strategies and objectives.
controls.ai_notes: Clear directive for the Board to establish a governance framework.

controls.title: Approve IT Strategy
controls.description: The Board must formally approve the IT Strategy, ensuring it aligns with organizational goals and includes key operational elements.
controls.full_text: The BoD shall approve 'IT Strategy' covering overall design and plan of its operational framework including its vision and mission, stakeholders, business, work flow and processes, data processing, system access, adoption of best-in-class information security systems, practices and availability of IT resources.

Further, the FI(s) shall also put in place a strategic review process to ensure that the 'IT Strategy' remains relevant with the organizational strategies and direction to achieve business objectives.
controls.ai_notes: Strategic review process is explicitly required to maintain relevance.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Establish approval matrix for RFP and BRD
controls.description: Define an approval matrix for RFPs and BRDs to ensure proper authorization and accountability.
controls.full_text: FI(s) shall develop/update technology procurement policy covering approval matrix of RFP and BRD.

evidence_requirements.title: Board/Management Approval
evidence_requirements.description: Board resolution or management approval document

controls.title: Include vendor and asset selection criteria in procurement policy
controls.description: Ensure procurement policy includes detailed criteria for selecting vendors and technology assets, along with acquisition and monitoring processes.
controls.full_text: The technology procurement policy shall include types of technology assets for both hardware & software, types of vendors for hardware & software, selection criteria for vendors, acquisition process, payment procedures & monitoring, delivery assurance & verification process, technical vetting requirement and need assessment.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Identify and record functional, operational, and regulatory requirements in RFP/ITT
controls.description: Ensure RFPs and ITTs include all functional, operational, and regulatory requirements to guide vendor responses.
controls.full_text: FI(s) shall ensure that functional, operational and regulatory requirements are identified and recorded in Request-For-Proposals (RFP) or Invitations-To-Tender (ITT) in the bid solicitation process.

controls.title: Review RFP and BRD for alignment with IT strategy and business objectives
controls.description: Ensure that the RFP and BRD documents for new technology acquisitions align with the organization's IT strategy, business goals, and emerging technology trends.
controls.full_text: The RFP and BRD for any new technology acquisition shall be reviewed to ascertain comprehensiveness of the documents, their alignment with IT strategy & business objectives and technical alignments with emerging trends and technologies.
controls.ai_notes: Clear directive to review RFP and BRD for alignment.

controls.title: Obtain expert consultancy for procurement process if necessary
controls.description: Engage expert consultants for procurement processes when needed, ensuring reasons and justifications are documented.
controls.full_text: FI(s) may obtain expert consultancy/advisory services for the formulation of RFP/BRD/Procurement process, where it deems necessary, provided they record reasons and rationale for the same.
controls.ai_notes: Optional control; evidence requirements focus on documentation of rationale.

controls.title: Conduct system selection analysis to meet user and business requirements
controls.description: Perform a detailed analysis to ensure selected systems meet user needs, business goals, and compliance requirements.
controls.full_text: FI(s) shall conduct a system (hardware, software and services) selection analysis to ensure that user and business requirements are met, expected service levels are properly achieved as per contract agreements and all applicable legal/regulatory requirements are complied with.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear requirements for analysis and compliance.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Ensure transparent and competitive procurement processes
controls.description: Ensure that major procurements are conducted through a transparent and competitive process to promote fairness and accountability.
controls.full_text: FI(s) shall undergo a transparent and competitive process of acquisitions in major procurements.
controls.ai_notes: Clear directive for transparent procurement processes.

controls.title: Manage procurement process by independent unit and IT Steering Committee
controls.description: Ensure that an independent unit and the IT Steering Committee oversee procurement processes to maintain governance and accountability.
controls.full_text: The procurement process shall be managed by an independent unit and governed by IT Steering Committee for different scope/level/size of procurements.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear governance requirements.

controls.title: Form a forum to monitor technology procurement processes
controls.description: Establish a forum or structure to oversee and monitor technology procurement processes.
controls.full_text: FI(s) shall form an appropriate forum/structure to monitor the process of technology-related procurements.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear monitoring requirements.

controls.title: Ensure vendor delivery aligns with contract terms
controls.description: Verify that vendors deliver products and services in accordance with the agreed contract terms and conditions.
controls.full_text: FI(s) shall also ensure that vendors deliver hardware/software as per terms and conditions set in the contract/agreement.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear focus on vendor compliance.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Promote only tested and approved systems to production
controls.description: Ensure that only systems that have been thoroughly tested and approved are deployed to the production environment.
controls.full_text: FI(s) shall ensure that only properly tested and approved systems are promoted to the production environment.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear focus on system testing and approval.

evidence_requirements.title: Board/Management Approval
evidence_requirements.description: Board resolution or management approval document

controls.title: Identify and address contingency scenarios
controls.description: Identify potential contingency scenarios and implement measures to address them, including system faults, hardware failures, and datacenter outages.
controls.full_text: Identify and address various types of contingency scenarios, which may be caused by system faults, hardware malfunction, operating errors or security incidents and total incapacitation of the primary Datacenter.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear focus on contingency planning.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Evaluate and update recovery plan annually
controls.description: Review and update the recovery plan and incident response procedures annually or when significant changes occur.
controls.full_text: Evaluate the recovery plan and incident response procedures at least annually and update them as and when changes to business operations, systems and networks occur.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear focus on annual review and updates.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Implement replication and rapid recovery capabilities
controls.description: Ensure systems and applications have mechanisms for replication and quick recovery to minimize downtime during disruptions.
controls.full_text: Implement replication, rapid backup and recovery capabilities at the individual system or application cluster level.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Consider interdependencies in recovery planning
controls.description: Account for how critical systems depend on each other when creating recovery plans and testing contingencies.
controls.full_text: Consider inter-dependencies between critical systems in drawing up its recovery plan and conducting contingency tests.
controls.ai_notes: Interdependencies are implied but not explicitly detailed in the control.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Select DR specifications based on BIA
controls.description: Use the results of the Business Impact Analysis (BIA) to determine disaster recovery specifications that address threats and meet recovery goals.
controls.full_text: The selection of DR specifications shall be made according to the BIA to address the identified threats and to meet the recovery objectives.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Adopt approved and rehearsed recovery measures
controls.description: Ensure recovery measures are formally approved, tested, and rehearsed to confirm their effectiveness.
controls.full_text: Adopt approved, tested and rehearsed recovery measures.

evidence_requirements.title: Board/Management Approval
evidence_requirements.description: Board resolution or management approval document

controls.title: Test recovery requirements annually
controls.description: Conduct annual tests to ensure recovery requirements are effective and staff can execute recovery procedures.
controls.full_text: Test and validate, at least annually, the effectiveness of recovery requirements and the ability of staff to execute the necessary emergency and recovery procedures.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Cover various scenarios in DR tests
controls.description: Include diverse scenarios in disaster recovery tests, such as full site shutdowns and individual component failures.
controls.full_text: Cover various scenarios in disaster recovery tests including total shutdown/complete switchover of the primary site as well as component failure at the individual system or application cluster level.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Test recovery dependencies between systems
controls.description: Verify that recovery dependencies between systems are tested to ensure seamless recovery.
controls.full_text: Test the recovery dependencies between systems.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Conduct BCP/DR drills with third parties annually
controls.description: Conduct annual BCP/DR drills involving third parties to ensure coordinated recovery efforts.
controls.full_text: BCP/DR drills planned with third parties, if any, shall be performed annually.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Include all aspects in BCP testing
controls.description: Ensure BCP tests cover all organizational aspects, including people, processes, and technology, and that staff are familiar with the plans.
controls.full_text: Testing of BCP shall include all aspects and constituents of a bank i.e. people, processes and resources (including technology). BCP tests shall ensure that all members of the recovery team and relevant staff are aware of the plans.

controls.title: Involve business users in DR test design
controls.description: Engage business users in designing and executing test cases to ensure recovered systems meet functional requirements.
controls.full_text: Involve business users in the design and execution of comprehensive test cases to verify that recovered systems function properly.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Participate in service provider DR tests
controls.description: Ensure active participation in disaster recovery tests conducted by service providers, including offshore systems, to validate recovery capabilities.
controls.full_text: Participate in disaster recovery tests that are conducted by its service provider(s), including those systems, which are located offshore.
controls.ai_notes: Participation is explicitly required, but evidence specifics are inferred.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Involve business heads in DR-BCP test sign-off
controls.description: Ensure business group/unit heads review and approve the results of DR-BCP drills to confirm alignment with business needs.
controls.full_text: Involve the respective business group heads/unit heads while signing-off test results of DR-BCP drills.
controls.ai_notes: Sign-off requirement is explicit, but evidence specifics are inferred.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Define recovery priorities and objectives
controls.description: Establish clear recovery priorities and objectives, including RTO and RPO, to guide disaster recovery efforts.
controls.full_text: Define system recovery, business resumption priorities and establish specific recovery objectives including Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) for IT systems and applications.
controls.ai_notes: Clear SHALL requirement for defining recovery objectives.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Establish geographically separated recovery site
controls.description: Implement strategies to ensure network redundancy for offshore outsourcing arrangements, minimizing risks of cross-border disruptions.
controls.full_text: Establish a recovery site that is geographically separated from the primary site to enable the restoration of critical systems and resumption of business operations in case of disruption at the primary site.
controls.ai_notes: Redundancy strategies are required, but evidence specifics are inferred.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Develop annual IT audit plan
controls.description: Create a comprehensive annual IT audit plan covering goals, schedules, resources, and reporting requirements.
controls.full_text: An annual audit plan detailing IT audit's budgeting and planning processes including audit goals, schedules, staffing needs and reporting requirements.
controls.ai_notes: Annual IT audit plan is explicitly required.

controls.title: Define audit report format
controls.description: Define and document the structure and content of audit reports to ensure they meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
controls.full_text: Audit report format.
controls.ai_notes: The control explicitly requires a defined format, making it a directive control.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Document maintenance and retention policy for IT findings
controls.description: Establish and enforce a policy for maintaining and retaining documentation related to IT audit findings.
controls.full_text: Document maintenance and retention policy for IT findings.
controls.ai_notes: Retention policies are typically mandatory for compliance.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Follow-up processes for significant IT audit findings
controls.description: Establish a process to track and address significant IT audit findings to ensure timely resolution.
controls.full_text: Follow-up processes for significant IT audit findings.
controls.ai_notes: High priority due to the focus on significant findings.

controls.title: Identify weaknesses and review management's plans
controls.description: Identify control weaknesses, recommend improvements, and evaluate management's remediation plans.
controls.full_text: Identification of weaknesses, providing meaningful recommendations and reviewing management's plans for addressing those weaknesses.
controls.ai_notes: Focuses on risk identification and management review.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Review adequacy of general controls
controls.description: Assess the adequacy of general IT controls across various operational and strategic areas.
controls.full_text: Reviewing the adequacy of general controls in place covering areas such as IT strategic & business planning, IT operations, DR/BCP, IT outsourcing, information security, development and acquisitions, ADCs, IT Procurements and Project Management.
controls.ai_notes: Covers a broad range of IT governance areas.

controls.title: Comprehensive audit of CSP arrangements
controls.description: Conduct regular audits of financial institutions' arrangements with cloud service providers to ensure compliance and risk management.
controls.full_text: A regular, comprehensive audit of FI(s) arrangements with the CSPs.
controls.ai_notes: Focuses on vendor risk management and compliance.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Application System Review (ASR)
controls.description: Perform a detailed review of application systems to ensure controls are in place to protect data confidentiality, integrity, and accuracy.
controls.full_text: Application System Review (ASR) to identify, document, test and evaluate the application controls to ensure confidentiality, integrity and accuracy of the systems and the related data/information.
controls.ai_notes: Critical for ensuring application security and data integrity.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Report IT audit findings and conclusions
controls.description: Ensure that IT audit findings, conclusions, and recommendations are documented and shared, including any limitations in scope.
controls.full_text: Report the findings, conclusions, recommendations and qualifications or limitations in scope with respect to the IT audit.
controls.ai_notes: Directive language indicates mandatory reporting of findings.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Discuss draft report with management
controls.description: Engage management in reviewing the draft audit report to ensure accuracy and alignment before finalization.
controls.full_text: Discuss the draft report contents with management in the subject area prior to finalization and release of the final report.
controls.ai_notes: Implicit requirement to engage management in discussions before finalization.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Ensure report is signed, dated, and distributed
controls.description: Finalize the audit report by signing, dating, and distributing it in accordance with the audit program's requirements.
controls.full_text: Ensure that report is signed, dated and distributed according to the format as defined in the audit program.
controls.ai_notes: Clear directive to ensure proper finalization and distribution of reports.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.full_text: Periodically submit a consolidated report to the Audit Committee on information/cyber security.
controls.ai_notes: Periodic submission is explicitly required.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.description: Provide the Audit Committee with updates on IT service delivery and operational performance.

evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.ai_notes: Explicit requirement for periodic reporting.

evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Submit consolidated report on IT project management
controls.description: Provide the Audit Committee with updates on IT project management, acquisition, and development activities.
controls.full_text: Periodically submit a consolidated report to the Audit Committee on IT project management, acquisition & development.
controls.ai_notes: Explicit requirement for periodic reporting.

controls.title: Submit consolidated report on IT procurement

controls.ai_notes: Explicit requirement for periodic reporting.

controls.title: Submit consolidated report on performance management
controls.description: Provide the Audit Committee with updates on IT performance management metrics and outcomes.

controls.ai_notes: Explicit requirement for periodic reporting.

controls.title: Submit consolidated report on BCP and DRP

controls.full_text: Periodically submit a consolidated report to the Audit Committee on BCP & DRP.
controls.ai_notes: Explicit requirement for periodic reporting.

controls.title: Ensure senior management approves audit recommendation procedures
controls.description: Senior management must formally approve procedures to ensure audit recommendations are implemented promptly.
controls.full_text: The audit function shall ensure that senior management approves a procedure to ensure timely implementation of audit recommendations.

evidence_requirements.title: Board/Management Approval
evidence_requirements.description: Board resolution or management approval document

controls.title: Monitor implementation of corrective actions
controls.description: The audit team must track and verify that corrective actions recommended by audits are being implemented effectively.
controls.full_text: The audit function shall monitor the implementation of management's corrective actions.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Communicate status of recommendations to BoD or Audit Committee
controls.description: The audit team must provide quarterly updates to the Board of Directors or Audit Committee on the status of audit recommendations.
controls.full_text: The audit function shall communicate status of the recommendations to the BoD or Audit Committee at least on a quarterly basis.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Integrate technology risks with enterprise risk management
controls.description: Technology risks must be incorporated into the broader enterprise risk management framework to ensure comprehensive risk oversight.
controls.full_text: Ensure that technology risks are integrated with the enterprise risk management function to achieve security, reliability, resiliency, interoperability and recoverability of data/information and information assets.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Approve and periodically review technology-related policies
controls.description: Technology-related policies must be formally approved and reviewed at least every three years or when significant changes occur.
controls.full_text: Approve all technology-related policies and review the same periodically in light of major technological/regulatory developments at least after every three (03) years.

evidence_requirements.title: Board/Management Approval
evidence_requirements.description: Board resolution or management approval document

controls.title: Maintain independent and effective technology audit function
controls.description: The organization must have an independent technology audit function that aligns with the complexity of its technology risks.
controls.full_text: Ensure maintenance of an independent and effective technology audit function commensurate with the complexity of FI(s) technology risk profile.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of policy implementation and compliance

controls.title: Fulfill resource gaps identified by management
controls.description: Management must address resource gaps in personnel, processes, and technology promptly to ensure operational effectiveness.
controls.full_text: Ensure that resource gaps (people, process & technology) identified by the management are adequately and timely fulfilled.

controls.title: Ensure sufficient and up-to-date skills for technology governance
controls.description: The organization must ensure that personnel have the necessary and current skills for technology governance and related functions.
controls.full_text: Ensure that the skills required for technology governance, service delivery, information security and risk management are sufficient and up-to-date.

evidence_requirements.title: Policy Compliance Records
